integrity: Proof supplied for the new unique-interior fixed-point, spectral classification, global deterministic attraction, and bipartite boundary. Claims are self-reviewed; novelty is subject to independent publication-priority checks.
limitations: Finite connected undirected nonbipartite weighted networks, strictly positive static biases with at least one nonneutral value, and fractional-linear binary opinion response. No directed-network or general nonlinear-response claim; stochastic almost-sure convergence invokes published equilibrium-set convergence and boundary-repulsion theorems.
